remarks: Prime South Buffalo location! This two unit 2/1 property offers an excellent opportunity for investors or owner occupants alike. Both units are currently occupied on a month to month basis, providing immediate rental income and flexibility for future ownership plans. Both units feature hardwood floors and open living spaces. Recent updates include one new hot water tank, a newer HVAC system, a sump pump approximately 2 years old, and a roof less than 13 years old. A solid investment in a desirable South Buffalo location with convenient access to local amenities, shopping, dining, parks, and major roadways. A great opportunity to add a operational and occupied two unit to your portfolio or live in one unit while generating rental income from the other. Gross rent currently $21,600/yr.
